comparison.objective: Pull an extinguisher pin, read its gauge and file the correct report; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Linear pin extraction, visual gauge interpretation and tag placement versus fine hex fastening, rotary adjustment and dynamic response testing.
comparison.success_condition: Pin displaced at least 2 cm and tag within 2.5 cm of the correct pad versus two bounded, repeatable carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Inspection and reporting with a simple extraction do not duplicate mechanical tuning and validation.
